thread:
Priya R: Heads-up: embassy pushed my visa interview by 3 days so I had to rebook from the nonrefundable $320 ticket to a refundable one ($620) on my personal card. Change fee was $45. Is the $300 difference + fee reimbursable? Booking: ZX9-77. I attached the embassy notice and receipts.
Jordan (People Ops): @Priya R thanks for flagging. Did you try contacting travel@redwood.com first or was this same-day and unavoidable?
Priya R: It was same-day, embassy emailed late evening. Travel desk wasn't reachable and the meeting with the client couldn't move.
Finance Bot: Policy excerpt: Emergency rebookings due to official travel document delays (visa, passport issues) may be reimbursed when supported by documentation (official notice) and manager approval in the expense. Airline premium differences and published change fees are considered reimbursable in these cases. Personal convenience upgrades are not.
Travel Desk (Amelia): For future: if travel desk can't respond, take a screenshot of the email and cc travel@redwood.com when you rebook. That helps with audit trail. We can occasionally retro-authorize but need evidence.
Priya R: Okay I've got embassy_email.pdf, new_e_ticket.pdf, change_fee_receipt.png, card_stmt.pdf uploaded. Who should approve this? My manager is OOO until tomorrow.
Marco - Travel Admin: Manager approval required per workflow. If manager is unavailable, ask the skip-level or People Ops for interim approval. Please add a note in the expense: "Interim approval requested - People Ops/Finance to confirm".
Jordan (People Ops): I can provide interim approval if manager unreachable, but need a brief attestation message here from Priya describing the timeline and attach the embassy notice. Priya: can you paste the embassy message here (short)?
Priya R: Embassy message: "Appointment moved from 6/12 to 6/15 due to staffing." Rebooked on 6/12 at 22:10 local time to a refundable fare. Tickets attached.
Jordan (People Ops): Thanks. I approve given the emergency and business need. Please add: "People Ops interim approval: Jordan" in the expense comments.
Priya R: Done. Posted expense report with two line items: fare difference $300 (Travel - Airfare) and change fee $45 (Travel - Fees). Marked payment method Personal Card.
Finance Bot: Automated check: total $345 flagged for manual review because exceeds $250 policy threshold for auto-approve. Policy note: exceptions for documented emergencies are allowed but require manual Finance sign-off. @Jordan (People Ops) please confirm approval present in expense metadata.
Jordan (People Ops): Confirmed. I added the attestation comment and included the timeline.
Finance Bot: Manual review assigned. Expected processing within 2 business days. If VAT reclaim is eligible, the VAT portion (if any) is processed as company reclaim; employee will not be charged VAT reclaim admin fees.
Priya R: Quick Q: the airline invoice shows a small VAT amount on the fare differential. Do I need to do anything special?
Marco - Travel Admin: Attach the invoice with VAT line. Finance will evaluate reclaim eligibility. If recoverable, we credit the company; reimbursement to employee is for the net cost they paid.
Priya R: Great, thanks everyone. Appreciate Jordan stepping in.
Jordan (People Ops): No problem. Ping me if Finance holds it up and I'll expedite.
Priya R: Will do. :pray:
